purpose: Teach: 損益/総研/送金/搭乗/事後/カ年/みなし/即し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の損益、総研の見通しと比べてどうだ。
lines.en: How does this quarter's P&L compare to the think tank's projections?
lines.style: Direct, businesslike opening. Expectant pause at the dash. Measured pace — asking for specifics, not small talk. Slight forward lean in posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。送金関連の手数料、見直しが必要です。
lines.en: Yes. The remittance-related fees will need to be reassessed.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Measured cadence on each item. Professional deference without hesitation — he's thought this through. Small breath before 'reassessed' to signal this is firm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員の搭乗、海外視察、事後報告を徹底させろ。
lines.en: Make sure executives log all flights, overseas inspections, and submit reports afterwards. Non-negotiable.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Hard consonants on 'Make' and 'log.' Short, declarative sentences. Steady eye contact. No warmth, no negotiation in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。3カ年計画、みなし会計のルールに即して再構築します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll rebuild the three-year plan to align with the deemed-accounting framework.
lines.style: Composed confirmation. Even pace, each phrase deliberate. Slight emphasis on 'rebuild' and 'align' — showing he understands the scope. Formal but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Good. We'll present it at the board meeting next week.
lines.style: Closing statement, slightly lighter than the others. Decisive nod in the voice. Short, settled. Implicit: this conversation is done, next phase begins.
